name: Admin — audit log lists recorded actions with who and when

planSteps.description: A table of audit entries is shown, each row naming an action, the user who performed it and a timestamp
At least one entry shows a recognisable action name in capitals with underscores, such as SETTINGS_UPDATE or COMPLAINT_STATUS_UPDATE
The entries are listed newest first

description: The audit log lists recorded system actions newest first, each naming the action, the user who performed it and when — the R.A. 10173 accountability trail every data mutation is required to write.
